module JC_counter(
   input                clk ,
   input                rst_n,
   output reg [63:0]     Q  
);

// Johnson Counter Implementation
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        Q <= 64'b0; // Reset the counter to all zeros
    end else begin
        if (Q[0] == 1'b0) begin
            Q <= {Q[63], Q[63:1]}; // Shift right and insert 1 at MSB
        end else begin
            Q <= {Q[63], Q[63:1]}; // Shift right and insert 0 at MSB
        end
    end
end

endmodule

    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);
    
    reg [1:0] state;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (~rst_n) begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Initialize to idle state
            data_out <= 1'b0; // Default output value
        end
        else begin
            case(state)
                2'b00: begin // State 0: Waiting for rising edge
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 2'b01; // Transition to rising edge state
                    end
                end
                2'b01: begin // State 1: Rising edge detected
                    if (~data_in) begin
                        state <= 2'b10; // Transition to falling edge state
                    end
                end
                2'b10: begin // State 2: Falling edge detected after rising edge
                    if (data_in) begin
                        state <= 2'b11; // Transition to pulse detected state
                        data_out <= 1'b1; // Output pulse detected
                    end
                    else begin
                        state <= 2'b00; // Reset to idle state
                    end
                end
                2'b11: begin // State 3: Pulse detected
                    state <= 2'b00; // Reset to idle state
                    data_out <= 1'b0; // Reset output after one clock cycle
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
